text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: (I see it! Beyond the horizon... the island of my dreams!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone gives up and abandons ship along the way.
However...)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: (I can reach it! That's right—)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Once our hands are full of companions
rowing forward together!
WOOOOOOOOOOOH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City!!!!
She crosses the finish line in first!! And—

text_block_list.name: 500 Companions
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What is this roar sweeping through the stands?!
What is this massive cheer?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's like a wave! A massive wave!
I've never seen such passionate fans before." his
Not typical fans. A crowd unlike any other Umamusume's gave Tap Dance City courage.

They are—comrades of the soul.
Not merely cheering you on, but sharing in
every single joy and sorrow alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm back, Navigator.
Well? Was that run everything you envisioned?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Was I off by a tenth of a second, or a tenth of a foot?
It was dead on, wasn't it?"

I used to struggle just to convey strategies to her.
But now, even without saying a word, we naturally arrive at the same answer.
Without exaggeration—we were one.
Without exaggeration—we were one.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, then let's start with a celebratory toast between the two of us,
my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Raise the glass of your soul!

Nodding, you raise the empty glass to the sky.
And then――

text_block_list.name: 500 Companions
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOH!

text_block_list.name: 500 Companions
text_block_list.text: Tap! Tap! Tap! Tap!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! What an impatient bunch.
They've already got huge grins on their faces before I'm even back.

text_block_list.name: 500 Companions
text_block_list.text: Tap! Tap! Tap! Tap!

Tap Dance City's movements suddenly halted,
as if she were completely enchanted by something.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: This... scenery is...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we've always been aiming
for the castle, haven't we...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A giant castle unshakeable by any reality.
To build that, I'm heading overseas.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Look over there.
Check it out, over there."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Can't you feel it?
A passion so strong it defies reality.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
They have lives too, you know.
School, work... but still...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: They braved those harsh realities to rush to our side. They even donated and supported us...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: A castle...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A castle. Even if there are no buildings yet,
my castle—lies right over there.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Our journey must go on.
Our journey continues, but...
perhaps we've finally arrived."

You nod. Indeed, Tap Dance City
going forward...

It will surely continue to be supported
by the unwavering enthusiasm of all 500 people.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! Hey everyone,
did watching my run blow your minds?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I feel absolutely amazing today! And—
I'm not the only one who's at the top of their game.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
My friends too! They're all experiencing
the exact same special feeling.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Right, guys!?

text_block_list.name: 500 Companions
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!!

A magnificent call-and-response.
We were already a single, united group.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha, they really are adorable.
It's precisely because I wanted to share joy
with them that...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I won. I can stand here smiling.
So...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Listen here! To everyone who loves Umamusume with a mad passion, I have a favor to ask."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If you ever find an Umamusume you truly care about
down the road, promise me you'll stand by her side.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Appearance and pedigree don't mean a damn thing.
Don't let crap like that decide your future!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
As long as you have comrades, you can do anything.
A world where anyone has a chance.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time!
Let's make it that kind of Twinkle Series!
It's a promise!
WAAAAAAAAH!

Cheers erupted not just from her friends,
but from every single spectator in the venue.

And so, with the hopes of five hundred people
as the wind at her back, Tap Dance City
forced open the doors to the future.
